source.title: Italy Elective Residence Visa Requirements Reference

taxonomy_fields.label: Are you applying as an individual or with family dependents?
Which Italian consulate will process your application?
Do you intend to work while living in Italy under this visa?
taxonomy_fields.description: This pathway is a passive-income / no-work residence visa, not a digital nomad or remote-work visa.

taxonomy_fields.label: Is your purpose to establish stable residence in Italy rather than stay as an extended tourist?
What is your annual passive or private income in EUR?
taxonomy_fields.description: Italy Elective Residence screening uses EUR 31,000/year as a reference point, but consulates may require more.

taxonomy_fields.label: Which sources will you rely on to meet the financial requirement?
How much do you have in available financial assets, in EUR?
How many dependents are included in your application?
Do the adult children included in your application live with you and depend financially on you?
What type of accommodation will you have in Italy?
Will you have health insurance valid in Italy covering medical care and hospitalization for the full stay?
How many months will your passport remain valid beyond your intended visa or stay period?
Was your passport issued within the last 10 years?

post_eligibility_checklist.note: These are real Italy Elective Residence obligations/document requirements sourced from requirements_reference.md, but they describe post-entry compliance steps or consulate-specific document logistics rather than pre-visa eligibility facts. They were removed from (or never added to) the live eligibility-screening flow and are preserved here for a future post-eligibility checklist / application-preparation surface. Their former or associated requirement codes still exist in clarifications.json and output.json for that purpose and are never emitted by rules.py's live eligibility screening.

fields.label: Do you understand you must apply for a permesso di soggiorno within 8 days of entering Italy?
Do you understand the permit is renewed annually only if income, housing, insurance, and other requirements remain satisfied?
How many blank passport pages do you have available?
fields.description: Paris guidance requests at least two blank passport pages when filing.

fields.label: If filing through San Francisco, can you provide an FBI Identity History Summary issued within the last 6 months?
